text:
Priya K.: morning handoff — quick status and a few asks

Priya K.: hey team, handing off to @Sam O. for the evening. No active incidents. Quick notes:
- Deploy 3.2.1 finished at 09:10 UTC, rollout stayed at 12% for 15m then reached 100% with no errors.
- Observability: token latency spike in eu-west at ~08:40, looks tied to an autoscaler thrash on the redis cache group.
- Known risk: cache group `session-cache-eu` is at 85% memory, evictions are up. We should watch tokenization failures if it crosses 90%.

Sam O.: thanks — taking over. Can you paste the autoscaler logs?

Priya K.: pasted below: 
```
2026-03-17T08:38:42Z autoscaler: scale-down triggered for redis-node-7 (mem=75%)\n2026-03-17T08:39:01Z autoscaler: scale-up triggered for redis-node-7 (mem=88%)\n2026-03-17T08:39:15Z autoscaler: scale-down canceled (pending connections > 100)
```

Taylor R.: fyi I opened a ticket (S-4421) to bump the redis cluster plan for eu-west. It's scheduled for next week but we can also add a short-term workaround.

Lee M.: short-term workaround suggestion: enable additional replica for `session-cache-eu` (manual) + bump eviction-policy to volatile-lru. Will need a quick window (2-3m) to add replica.

Sam O.: sounds good. Priya, any ongoing canary traffic rules we should keep?

Priya K.: canary routes are fine. Note: canary for recommender model is pinned to model-v1.4 on the us-east pool — no change required.

oncall-bot: reminder — weekly oncall checklist due in 4h :calendar: (https://redwood.internal/checklists/oncall-weekly)

Sam O.: action items for tonight:
1) Monitor `session-cache-eu` memory/evictions for next 6h (alerts at 90%).
2) If evictions > 0.5% sustained for 5m, call Lee for manual replica add (pager duty: +1) and notify infra team.
3) Keep an eye on token latency in eu-west and report any > 250ms p50 for chat endpoints.
4) Tag S-4421 in any postmortem notes if we see related user impact.

Taylor R.: I'll update the ticket with the autoscaler logs and add the temporary mitigation notes.

Lee M.: ready to add replica if you ping. I have a 30m window starting 18:10 UTC.

Sam O.: thanks — I'll hold off unless we hit thresholds. Ping me directly for real-time handoff.

Priya K.: thanks all. small FYI: code review for #8276 (kv-cache optimization) needs a quick pair review if anyone has bandwidth — low priority but helpful for tomorrow's perf tests.

Taylor R.: I can skim it after lunch, leave a note in the PR.

Sam O.: noted. closing handoff — leaving watchlist: `session-cache-eu` mem, eu-west token latency, deploy 3.2.1 health. Ping in thread or @Sam O. for urgent. :thumbsup:
